title: Auxiliary Manifest
description: Catalogs project regions outside the OTEL telemetry surface (docs, .github, etc.). Lives at .principal-views/auxiliary.manifest.json.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema for editor autocomplete.

areas.description: Project areas — folders or files that support the project but don't emit OTEL telemetry.

name.description: Display name. Must be unique across all areas in the manifest.

paths.description: Repo-relative paths owned by this area. Folder or file. Must not overlap other areas or any scope path.

description.description: Free-text purpose — a sentence about why this folder exists.
